Weekly FinTech Digest

Автор: Linas Beliūnas

https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/nubank-launched-35-countries-without-single-banking-license-beli%C5%ABnas-cihof?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3Bg%2F%2BpIxwKRQSwtXKC0MEbTQ%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=1jlKge21o2mss1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mujlgdax~ui-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mujlgdax-ui
  
👋 Hey, Linas here! Welcome to a 🔓 weekly free edition 🔓 of my daily newsletter. Each day, I focus on 3 stories that are making a difference in the financial technology space. Coupled with things worth watching & most important money movements, it’s the only newsletter you need for all things when Finance meets Tech. If you’re not a subscriber, here’s what you missed last week: The Anthropic IPO: Top 10 Stocks Positioned to Benefit Most 💸 [How smart capital is buying Anthropic before the $2 trillion listing] The Agentic Transition Playbook 🧠 [How founders and builders win when software starts building itself] How to Use GPT-6 Astra, the OpenAI Model Jensen Huang Called AGI 🤖 [8 GPT-6 Astra workflows, copy-ready prompts, and practical settings for founders, builders, investors, and entrepreneurs who want to build products, research investments, and get more value from AI] The Ultimate Guide to Grok Bot: The First Real AI Agent OS 🤖 [The complete guide to building a persistent AI agent operating system with Grok Bot — setup, working prompts, 8 end-to-end workflows, multi-agent teams, security, and the economics of AI teammates] The Age of the One-Person Company 🦄 [What the latest data reveals about solo founders building million-dollar companies with AI agents instead of employees, and where the next big opportunity is in 2026] The New Enterprise AI Go-To-Market Playbook 📚 [The a16z framework that decides which AI startups win the enterprise, and how founders can use it in 2026] OpenAI just built a Bloomberg competitor into ChatGPT 🤖📊 [why the hosted-data architecture matters more than model quality, why OpenAI is really competing with Bloomberg & FactSet for the data layer rather than with Anthropic for model scores, & what to watch for next + bonus deep dives into how to use GPT-6 Astra, and The Agentic Transition Playbook inside] No one hacked Revolut. That’s the problem 🤷‍♂️🛡️ [how attackers used a compromised Italian government mailbox to trick Revolut's compliance team into handing over passport scans, selfies & full transaction histories for 680 high-value customers, why those files are now being posted on Telegram daily with a 10,000 BTC ransom demand, & what this means for every bank that processes government data requests by email + bonus reads on Revolut, Agentic Commerce & more inside] UK banks plan
